# The Lantern Loop

The keep leans out of the fog like a bad tooth. The gate is **open**, which is
either luck or bait.

![The outer gate](gate.png)

You are carrying a lit torch. It will not last the night, and *you* know it.

---

> Every door in this place opens twice. Once for you, once for whatever
> follows you in.

choices.text: Push the gate open and step inside
Pinch out your torch first, then creep in
